sources.title: [2104.13615] MelBERT: Metaphor Detection via Contextualized Late ...
sources.snippet: To this end, we propose a novel metaphor detection model using metaphorical identification theories over the pre-trained contextualized model, namely metaphor-aware late interaction over BERT (MelBERT). MelBERT deals with a classification task to identify whether a target word in a sentence is metaphorical or not.
